name: TeleDrop Bot
description: Telegram file-sharing bot with expiring links and automatic cleanup

TG_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Bot token, Get it from @Botfather

OWNER_ID.description: An integer of consisting of your owner ID

APP_ID.description: your app id, take it from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: your api hash, take it from my.telegram.org

CHANNEL_ID.description: Database channel ID; add the bot as admin in this channel

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL1.description: Optional first force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL2.description: Optional second force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL3.description: Optional third force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL4.description: Optional fourth force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

START_MESSAGE.description: Optional: start message of bot, use HTML parsemode format
START_MESSAGE.value:
Hello {first}

I can store private files in Specified Channel and other users can access it from special link.

FORCE_SUB_MESSAGE.description: Optional: Force Sub message of bot, use HTML parsemode format

ADMINS.description: A space separated list of user_ids of Admins, they can only create links

TIME.description: Delivered-file auto-delete delay in seconds; use 0 to disable
